<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Bolas num nonágono em rotação</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; background: #0f1220; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas { background: #151a2e; border-radius: 12px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="cv" width="640" height="640"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var canvas = document.getElementById("cv");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  var CX = 320, CY = 320;
  var R = 260;
  var N = 9;
  var PERIOD = 7;
  var OMEGA = 2 * Math.PI / PERIOD; // positivo = horário no canvas (y para baixo)
  var BALL_R = 14;
  var NUM_BALLS = 13;
  var GRAVITY = 900;
  var REST = 0.82;
  var AIR = 0.08;
  var WALL_MU = 0.18;
  var BALL_MU = 0.05;
  var H = 1 / 240;

  var t = 0;
  var balls = [];
  var lastManual = -1e9;

  (function init() {
    var ring = 60;
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_BALLS; i++) {
      var a = (i / NUM_BALLS) * 2 * Math.PI;
      balls.push({
        id: i,
        x: CX + Math.cos(a) * ring,
        y: CY + Math.sin(a) * ring,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        r: BALL_R,
        spin: a,
        spinVel: 0
      });
    }
  })();

  function polyAngle() {
    return OMEGA * t;
  }

  function vertices(angle) {
    var vs = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var a = angle + (i / N) * 2 * Math.PI;
      vs.push({ x: CX + Math.cos(a) * R, y: CY + Math.sin(a) * R });
    }
    return vs;
  }

  function edgeNormals(vs) {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var A = vs[i], B = vs[(i + 1) % N];
      var dx = B.x - A.x, dy = B.y - A.y;
      var len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      var ex = dx / len, ey = dy / len;
      var n1x = -ey, n1y = ex;
      var nx = n1x, ny = n1y;
      if ((CX - A.x) * n1x + (CY - A.y) * n1y < 0) { nx = ey; ny = -ex; }
      out.push({ A: A, ex: ex, ey: ey, len: len, nx: nx, ny: ny });
    }
    return out;
  }

  // menor distância do centro da bola até à fronteira + normal interior
  function closestWall(b, vs) {
    var edges = edgeNormals(vs);
    var bestD = Infinity, best = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var e = edges[i];
      var d = (b.x - e.A.x) * e.nx + (b.y - e.A.y) * e.ny;
      if (d < bestD) {
        bestD = d;
        var tp = (b.x - e.A.x) * e.ex + (b.y - e.A.y) * e.ey;
        if (tp < 0) tp = 0;
        if (tp > e.len) tp = e.len;
        best = {
          nx: e.nx, ny: e.ny,
          qx: e.A.x + e.ex * tp, qy: e.A.y + e.ey * tp
        };
      }
    }
    return { d: bestD, n: best };
  }

  function collideWalls(angle) {
    var vs = vertices(angle);
    for (var bi = 0; bi < balls.length; bi++) {
      var b = balls[bi];
      var cw = closestWall(b, vs);
      if (cw.d < b.r) {
        var pen = b.r - cw.d;
        b.x += cw.n.nx * pen;
        b.y += cw.n.ny * pen;
        var rx = cw.n.qx - CX, ry = cw.n.qy - CY;
        var wvx = -OMEGA * ry, wvy = OMEGA * rx;
        var rvx = b.vx - wvx, rvy = b.vy - wvy;
        var vn = rvx * cw.n.nx + rvy * cw.n.ny;
        if (vn < 0) {
          var j = -(1 + REST) * vn;
          b.vx += j * cw.n.nx;
          b.vy += j * cw.n.ny;
          var tx = -cw.n.ny, ty = cw.n.nx;
          var vt = (b.vx - wvx) * tx + (b.vy - wvy) * ty;
          var maxF = WALL_MU * Math.abs(j);
          var dvt = Math.max(-maxF, Math.min(maxF, vt));
          b.vx -= dvt * tx;
          b.vy -= dvt * ty;
          b.spinVel -= dvt / b.r;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function collideBalls() {
    for (var i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      for (var j = i + 1; j < balls.length; j++) {
        var a = balls[i], b = balls[j];
        var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
        var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        var minD = a.r + b.r;
        if (d2 < minD * minD) {
          var d = Math.sqrt(d2);
          if (d < 1e-6) { d = 1e-6; dx = 1e-6; dy = 0; }
          var nx = dx / d, ny = dy / d;
          var pen = (minD - d) / 2;
          a.x -= nx * pen; a.y -= ny * pen;
          b.x += nx * pen; b.y += ny * pen;
          var rvx = b.vx - a.vx, rvy = b.vy - a.vy;
          var vn = rvx * nx + rvy * ny;
          if (vn < 0) {
            var jimp = -(1 + REST) * vn / 2;
            a.vx -= jimp * nx; a.vy -= jimp * ny;
            b.vx += jimp * nx; b.vy += jimp * ny;
            var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
            var vt = rvx * tx + rvy * ty;
            var maxF = BALL_MU * Math.abs(jimp * 2);
            var dvt = Math.max(-maxF, Math.min(maxF, vt));
            a.vx += (dvt / 2) * tx; a.vy += (dvt / 2) * ty;
            b.vx -= (dvt / 2) * tx; b.vy -= (dvt / 2) * ty;
            a.spinVel -= dvt / a.r;
            b.spinVel += dvt / b.r;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function clampInside() {
    var vs = vertices(polyAngle());
    for (var i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      var b = balls[i];
      var cw = closestWall(b, vs);
      if (cw.d < b.r) {
        var pen = b.r - cw.d;
        b.x += cw.n.nx * pen;
        b.y += cw.n.ny * pen;
      }
    }
  }

  function subStep(h) {
    var i, b;
    for (i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      b = balls[i];
      b.vy += GRAVITY * h;
      var drag = 1 - AIR * h;
      b.vx *= drag;
      b.vy *= drag;
      b.x += b.vx * h;
      b.y += b.vy * h;
      b.spinVel += (b.vx / b.r) * h * 0.3;
      b.spinVel *= 1 - 0.3 * h;
      b.spin += b.spinVel * h;
    }
    for (var it = 0; it < 4; it++) {
      collideWalls(polyAngle());
      collideBalls();
    }
    clampInside();
    t += h;
  }

  function step(dt) {
    if (!(dt > 0)) return;
    if (dt > 0.25) dt = 0.25;
    var remaining = dt;
    while (remaining > 1e-9) {
      var h = Math.min(H, remaining);
      subStep(h);
      remaining -= h;
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var vs = vertices(polyAngle());
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(vs[0].x, vs[0].y);
    for (var i = 1; i < N; i++) ctx.lineTo(vs[i].x, vs[i].y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(122,162,255,0.06)";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#7aa2ff";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.stroke();
    for (i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      var b = balls[i];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
      ctx.rotate(b.spin);
      var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-4, -4, 2, 0, 0, b.r);
      g.addColorStop(0, "#ffd97a");
      g.addColorStop(1, "#d96a35");
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2b1a05";
      ctx.font = "bold 12px monospace";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(String(b.id), 0, 0);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  var last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    if (dt > 0 && now - lastManual > 1000) {
      step(dt);
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  draw();

  window.__bench = {
    getState: function () {
      return {
        t: t,
        poly: {
          n: 9,
          radius: R,
          cx: CX,
          cy: CY,
          angle: polyAngle(),
          periodSec: PERIOD
        },
        balls: balls.map(function (b) {
          return { id: b.id, x: b.x, y: b.y, r: b.r, vx: b.vx, vy: b.vy };
        })
      };
    },
    step: function (dt) {
      lastManual = performance.now();
      step(dt);
      draw();
    }
  };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

part.text:
Quick check of the physics logic: walls are at distance d from the center. If the polygon is a regular nonagon with inradius r_in = 260*cos(π/9) ≈ 253, then the balls (radius 14) can touch a wall. The initial placement of the balls is on a ring of radius 60, spacing is 2π*60/13 ≈ 29px > 28, no problem.

Collisions with the walls: wall velocity = omega × r (relative to the center), omega = OMEGA, in screen coordinates with y pointing down, the angular velocity is OMEGA in the clockwise direction. The vertices rotate by +OMEGA per unit time, so d/dt of the position of a fixed material point = OMEGA * perp(r). Correct as written.

Deterministic stepping: step(dt) divides into substeps of 1/240, deterministic. Good.

One concern: if the balls overlap heavily, the iterative collision solver might not fully separate them, but with 4 iterations + clampInside it should be fine.

Done.

Ficheiro criado em `index.html`. Simulação autónoma com:

- Nonágono regular (raio 260, centro 320,320) a rodar 360°/7s no sentido horário
- 13 bolas (raio 14) com spin desenhado por cima, iniciadas em anel próximo do centro
- Física própria: gravidade, arrasto do ar, fricção de contacto (parede e bola-bola), restituição 0.82, velocidade da parede no ponto de impacto incluída na resposta
- `window.__bench.getState()` no formato exato pedido e `window.__bench.step(dt)` determinístico (substeps de 1/240 s), com `requestAnimationFrame` a correr quando não há passos manuais
